item.title: Brooklyn residents say they've been without heat for weeks -- and that's not all
item.description: Residents at an apartment building in Brooklyn say they have been forced to get creative since their heat has been out - and that's not the only issue they're facing.

item.title: Mamdani to call for tax hike, citing $12B budget deficit from Adams administration
item.description: Mamdani has said he wants households making more than $1 million to pay an additional 2% in taxes.

item.title: 1 dead, 15 others injured in Eastchester high-rise fire and explosion
item.description: The fire started on the 15th floor of the Boston Secor Houses. The FDNY was on the scene at the time to investigate a possible gas leak in the building.

item.title: Texas man convicted of 2 fatal shootings becomes the 1st person executed in the US this year
item.description: Charles Victor Thompson received a lethal injection Wednesday evening at the state penitentiary in Huntsville, Texas.

item.title: Man charged in Eastchester high-rise fire and explosion that killed 1, injured 15 others
item.description: Detectives charged 55-year-old Samuel Calderon, who is homeless, with two counts of murder, manslaughter, assault, burglary, petit larceny, criminal contempt and harassment.

item.title: Bridges Outreach connects people with warming centers, food in dangerous temperatures
item.description: The Bridges Outreach team is providing shuttle buses to warming centers and shelters for those who don't have anywhere to go.

item.title: NYCHA residents in Far Rockaway trying to cope without heat, hot water during brutal cold stretch
item.description: The city is promising to get the heat and hot water flowing again for a building full of people in Queens, who say they've been without it since before the weekend snowstorm.

item.title: The Museum of Broadway hosts event to raise awareness for bone marrow donations
item.description: The drive honors the memory of a former "Lion King" star who died at the age of 11 before she could find a bone marrow match.

item.title: Car slams into Chabad World Headquarters in Crown Heights, Brooklyn; driver in custody
item.description: Police were called to 770 Eastern Parkway where a grey Honda with New Jersey plates crashed near the entrance of Chabad World Headquarters at 8:46 p.m.

item.title: Search warrant FBI served at elections office near Atlanta seeks records tied to the 2020 elections
item.description: The search warrant the FBI served at a Fulton County elections office seeks records tied to the 2020 election, officials say.
